sourceSentences: Zeri generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts Burst Fire, up to a maximum of 100 charge.
At full charge, Zeri's next attack is empowered to consume all charge to deal magic damage (+ of target's maximum health).
Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are shielded or invulnerable while below the health threshold.
Zeri can cast Burst Fire even while silenced.
Burst Fire is still locked out while Zeri is affected by any form of other cast-inhibiting crowd control.

If the pulse hits terrain, it transforms into a laser in a line that grants sight of the area for 1.75 seconds and fires after 0.85 seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and critically striking against champions and monsters.
The pulse missile is blocked by projectile-interception effects but not the laser.
She will dash farther across terrain if Spark Surge was cast within 50 units of any.
Spark Surge's extended dash travels based on the thickness of the terrain, up to a maximum distance.
Spark Surge's current cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds whenever Zeri hits at least one enemy with a basic attack or Burst Fire, increased to 1.5 seconds if the latter critically strikes.
Spark Surge resets Zeri's basic attack timer and Burst Fire cooldown. Ultrashock Laser and Lightning Crash can be cast during the dash.
If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters Overcharged for 5 seconds.
Zeri can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.
V26.09: Cooldown reduction can now be triggered from hitting any enemy, rather than only enemy champions.
